learning_outcomes.text: Implement the concepts covered in digital information systems modules (SIN301 and SIN401) within a long project (36 hours of practical work).
Learn to master project presentation tools (report and oral presentation).

syllabus_topics: UselessBox: design of digital control electronics for a simple mechanical system and implementation on an FPGA.
Digital watch: design of digital control electronics for a system reproducing all functions of a digital watch and implementation on an FPGA.

Robotics: design of analog electronics (card manufacturing) and digital control electronics (FPGA) for a robot with the aim of participating in the IUT League of the UGA Robotics Challenge, or the French Robotics Cup.
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
